hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the door out is south

spots.line: Shelves to the ceiling, and a ladder nobody has moved in a while.
A table of open books, all of them held down with stones.
A map of the country with three towns on it that are not there any more.
Somebody has been copying the same page over and over. The hand gets worse.

chests.line: A case at the end of the stacks, and the catch has gone soft with age.
A drawer of nothing but ink, and one thing that is not ink.

people.name: Ondry the Keeper
chatter: Read what you like. Put it back where it was, not where it should be.
Half of this is wrong. I have not worked out which half.
The lamps stay lit. That is the whole of my duty and it takes all day.
Somebody copied a page badly two hundred years ago and we are all still living in it.

people.name: Wick the Duck Wizard
chatter: I am not lost. I am between shelves.
There is a book here that I am not allowed to want.
Quills. They ask where I get the quills. I do not answer.

people.name: a wisp above the stacks
chatter: It hangs over whichever page is being read, as if it were reading too.
